caption: Against a solid black background, a silhouetted hand grips the left edge of a flat, transparent circular disc with a central hole, displaying strong iridescent reflections. The disc exhibits concentric rainbow rings—a broad yellow-white band, a cyan-green band, and an inner purple-blue band—with a faint radial scratch crossing the upper-left. As the clip progresses, the disc undergoes a slow tilt or rotation relative to the stationary hand. This movement deforms the iridescent pattern, concentrating the bright yellow-white arc on the left while the right arcs thin out, shifting the nested rings into an offset, crescent-like arrangement. Concurrently, the dark central hole drifts leftward, and the thin outer rim circle foreshortens, its right edge gradually fading into the blackness. The multicolor rings and scratch line persist, their positions shifting as the disc's apparent orientation changes.
